# Northline Plumbing Co.

> Northline Plumbing Co. is a licensed and insured plumbing contractor serving Regina and southern Saskatchewan, offering 24/7 emergency repair, drain cleaning, water heater replacement and leak detection.

- **Location:** Regina, SK, Canada (service-area business, no walk-in storefront)
- **Phone:** (306) 555-0142
- **Emergency:** 24/7, live dispatcher, no overtime surcharge
- **Licensed:** SK Journeyperson Plumber Licence · $2M General Liability
- **Service radius:** 120 km from Regina
- **Rating:** 4.9/5 from 287 reviews

## Services

- [24/7 Emergency Plumbing](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/services/emergency-plumbing/): Burst pipes, major leaks and no-water emergencies answered around the clock.
- [Drain Cleaning & Unclogging](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/services/drain-cleaning/): Camera-inspected drain and sewer clearing that fixes the cause, not just the symptom.
- [Water Heater Repair & Install](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/services/water-heater-repair/): Tank and tankless diagnosis, replacement and same-day hot water restoration.
- [Leak Detection & Repair](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/services/leak-detection/): Acoustic and thermal location of hidden leaks before they wreck your drywall.
- [Faucet & Fixture Installation](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/services/faucet-fixture-installation/): Taps, toilets, sinks and shower valves fitted clean and leak-free.
- [Sewer Line Repair](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/services/sewer-line-repair/): Camera diagnosis, spot repair and full replacement for failed main lines.

## Service Areas

- [Regina](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/service-areas/regina/): Full city coverage including Harbour Landing, Lakeview, Cathedral and the Warehouse District.
- [Moose Jaw](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/service-areas/moose-jaw/): Serviced daily with the same 90-minute emergency target.
- [White City](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/service-areas/white-city/): Acreage and rural well-system experience.
- [Pilot Butte](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/service-areas/pilot-butte/): Frozen-line thaw specialists through the winter months.
- [Emerald Park](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/service-areas/emerald-park/): New-build rough-in and warranty work.
- [Lumsden](https://www.northlineplumbing.example/service-areas/lumsden/): Valley properties with sump and backflow needs.
